title: oldenlandia helferi
intro: Oldenlandia helferi, commonly known as Helfer's oldenlandia or Helfer's weed, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia helferi are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
